company.shortDescription: Leveling up gamers with expert coaching, localized content, and tournaments powering the next generation of esports champions.
company.description: PROCODE is MENA’s leading gaming and esports platform, helping gamers at all levels unlock their potential through localized content, structured training, expert coaching, and tournaments, building the region’s gaming infrastructure and shaping its esports future.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for competitive gamers to participate in tournaments, access coaching and learning content, connect with communities, and track performance.
productsAndServices.name: PROCODE Competitive Gaming Platform

productsAndServices.description: A competition service offering tournaments, head-to-head duels, seasonal circuits, and multi-tournament events across games such as VALORANT, EA FC, Rocket League, Tekken 8, and others.
productsAndServices.name: Tournaments and Competitions

productsAndServices.description: A marketplace for booking sessions with verified esports coaches, professional players, and high-rank competitors for training, gameplay reviews, and personalized feedback.
productsAndServices.name: Coaching Services

productsAndServices.description: Community features that help gamers find teammates, join teams, communicate with players, and participate in a network of creators, streamers, professionals, and community leaders.
productsAndServices.name: Community and Player Networking

productsAndServices.description: A learning service containing educational modules, premium content packs, and coaching guides that support player development and competitive gaming knowledge.
productsAndServices.name: Content Library and Learning

productsAndServices.description: An in-platform points system earned through competition, coaching, learning, and community activity, redeemable for selected PROCODE services and platform benefits.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $53,039, or 67.96% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $78,039, representing 100% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,359,691 to $2,359,691, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 47 (-20 over 90 days) and market heat at 42 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
